question: Which paper states that PaperServe routes only a selected context frontier to the reader?

candidate_papers.title: PaperServe: Context Frontiers for Evidence-Bounded Readers
candidate_papers.text: PaperServe routes a selected context frontier to the reader instead of passing every retrieved paper. Verification can request another retrieval when required evidence is absent.

candidate_papers.title: Workflow Scheduling for Background Jobs
candidate_papers.text: A scheduler decides job ordering and retry timing, but it does not select evidence for a reader context window.

candidate_papers.title: Custom Attention Kernels for Throughput
candidate_papers.text: Custom kernels can improve attention throughput but do not define a dependency-free paper-routing frontier.

expected_answer_points: PaperServe selects a bounded context frontier before reading.
The reader should not receive every retrieved paper.
